title: Steady state and transient absorption spectroscopy in metal halide perovskites
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,1644-1683
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00985A, Tutorial Review
Mehri Ghasemi, Junlin Lu, Baohua Jia, Xiaoming Wen
This review emphasizes absorption spectroscopy as a key technique for exploring MHPs, detailing advances in steady-state and transient methods across optical to THz ranges and diverse timescales, providing critical insights into their optoelectronic properties and device applications.
